rule.name: TDFD_filterRecordData
rule.description: Filters a list of record data
rule.definition: /* =====Change Log===== 2023/06/12 Ata Gurpinar - Added to CS Sandbox */ index( ri!recordData, a!match( value: ri!operator, equals: "=", then: wherecontains( tostring(ri!value), touniformstring(index(ri!recordData, ri!field, null)) ), equals: "<>", then: difference( enumerate(count(ri!recordData)) + 1, wherecontains( tostring(ri!value), touniformstring(index(ri!recordData, ri!field, null)) ) ), equals: ">=", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "<", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "<=", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "between", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "in", then: wherecontains( touniformstring(ri!value), touniformstring(index(ri!recordData, ri!field, null)) ), equals: "not in", then: difference( enumerate(count(ri!recordData)) + 1, wherecontains( touniformstring(ri!value), touniformstring(index(ri!recordData, ri!field, null)) ) ), equals: "is null", then: wherecontains( tostring(null), touniformstring(index(ri!recordData, ri!field, null)) ), equals: "not null", then: difference( enumerate(count(ri!recordData)) + 1, wherecontains( tostring(null), touniformstring(index(ri!recordData, ri!field, null)) ) ), equals: "starts with", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "not starts with", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "ends with", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "not ends with", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "includes", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ equals: "not includes", then: null, /*Future Functionality */ default: null ), null )
